commitResults.messageTitle: Add greeting
Add support for echo
Add support for list
Add project skill for visual change reviews
commitResults.messageBody: Bundle the present-changes-visually instructions, metadata, and HTML diff generator in the repository. This makes consistent visual comparisons available to future Codex sessions without requiring a separate skill installation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for marking tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody: Track completion state alongside task descriptions and handle mark commands by task number. Display each task's completion status when listing tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for marking tasks as not done
commitResults.messageBody: Handle unmark commands by clearing the selected task's completion state. Confirm the updated status and reject invalid task numbers without changing the task list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Represent tasks with a Task class
commitResults.messageBody: Encapsulate each task's description and completion state in a dedicated class. Refactor Phin to store Task objects and delegate status formatting, marking, and unmarking while preserving existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add project-specific UI regression testing
commitResults.messageBody: Create a reusable test-ui skill and exact-output runner so command-line behavior is checked consistently after code changes. Record the baseline Level 3 workflow and require UI test maintenance in AGENTS.md.

commitResults.messageTitle: Model todos, deadlines, and events using inheritance
commitResults.messageBody: Create Task subclasses that share completion behavior while providing type-specific polymorphic formatting. Keep date and time values as strings.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse and display typed task commands
commitResults.messageBody: Create todos, deadlines, and events from their command formats and store them polymorphically in the task list. Expand UI regression coverage for type-specific formatting, status changes, and free-form deadline text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid commands with Phin-specific exceptions
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize task-number validation and reject malformed task details so bad input cannot crash the chatbot or mutate its task list. Expand UI regression cases to preserve existing commands while exercising recovery after errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Strengthen UI regression guidance for parser changes
commitResults.messageBody: Require existing command coverage and interleaved valid-invalid cases so future error handling cannot silently remove behavior or corrupt task state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use an ArrayList for dynamic task storage
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the fixed-size task array and manual count with Java Collections so task storage can grow dynamically and support indexed removal cleanly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for deleting tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Handle validated delete commands with ArrayList removal, report the removed task and remaining count, and cover successful and rejected deletions in the UI regression plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save and restore tasks across restarts
commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks exist only in memory and are lost when Phin exits.
Users need their task list to survive between sessions.

Save accepted changes and restore task details and completion states
at startup. Use a relative path so storage works on other computers.
Reject corrupt files without overwriting them, and report save errors
so users know when changes remain only in memory.

Isolate UI tests to protect user data and cover persistence across
restarts. All 10 UI cases pass with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-7 to deliver task persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
Include tested saving and loading in master. Keep a merge commit to
record the Level 7 increment and preserve its development branch.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store deadline and event dates as LocalDate
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and event dates are free-form strings, so invalid calendar
values are accepted and dates cannot be compared reliably.

Parse ISO dates into LocalDate and display readable English dates.
Reject invalid dates and reversed event ranges before adding tasks.
Keep saved dates in ISO format so they survive restarts, and preserve
legacy files when their free-form dates cannot be loaded safely.

Retain command coverage and add calendar validation and restart cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-8 to support calendar dates
commitResults.messageBody:
Deliver typed dates and validated event ranges in master. Preserve
the increment's branch history with a non-fast-forward merge.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract console interactions into Ui
commitResults.messageBody:
Phin mixes console input and response formatting with command handling
and persistence, making presentation changes harder to isolate.

Move console reads and response formatting into Ui while preserving
command behavior, output text, and storage error handling. Keep parsing
and task mutations in Phin to make this a small, reviewable first step
toward A-MoreOOP.

Verify all 13 existing UI cases with Java 25 and exact output matching.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Phin mixes command interpretation with task updates and persistence,
which makes input rules harder to review independently.

Move command recognition, task construction, and task-number validation
into Parser. Keep execution and saving in Phin so this iteration stays
focused without introducing a command-class hierarchy.

Preserve exact command boundaries, error messages, and date validation.
Extend the UI plan with interleaved valid and invalid commands covering
prefix lookalikes, unexpected arguments, and invalid task numbers.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate task operations in TaskList
commitResults.messageBody:
Phin manages an ArrayList directly, mixing collection operations with
command execution and persistence coordination.

Introduce TaskList to own task ordering, additions, deletions, and
completion changes. Copy the loaded collection and expose unmodifiable
snapshots for display and saving, keeping Ui and Storage independent of
the new wrapper. The snapshots share task objects rather than deep-copying
them, which is sufficient for the existing read-only consumers.

Complete the minimum A-MoreOOP extraction with Ui, Storage, Parser, and
TaskList while preserving command output and persistence behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize application classes in the phin package
commitResults.messageBody:
Application classes live in the default package, leaving the source
layout without an explicit namespace.

Move all classes into phin while retaining src/main/java as the source
root. Use one package to keep this small application simple and preserve
existing access rules without adding unrelated refactoring.

Update the UI runner to discover nested sources and launch phin.Phin.
Document the package layout and console launch commands, and correct the
README greeting to match the application.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge Gradle support and configure Phin builds
commitResults.messageBody:
The project relies on manual compilation and has no reproducible build
entry point for application execution or later JUnit tests.

Merge the course add-gradle-support branch, retain its wrapper and plugin
versions, and configure phin.Phin as the application entry point. Select
a Java 25 toolchain and name the project and generated JAR for Phin.

Document wrapper commands, the first-run network requirement, and the
correct JAVA_HOME directory format. Keep the supplied JUnit and Shadow
configuration ready for their later increments without claiming JUnit
coverage before tests are added.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for core task logic
commitResults.messageBody:
Command behavior is verified through UI transcripts, but those tests
cannot directly check collection ownership or isolate parsing
failures.

Add focused unit tests for Parser, TaskDate, and TaskList. Cover command
boundaries, invalid numeric arguments, strict dates, event ranges,
status updates, deletion ordering, and snapshot semantics without
changing production behavior.

Keep the existing JUnit configuration and document how to run tests
and locate their report. Retain UI tests for console and persistence
coverage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Verify and document executable JAR distribution
commitResults.messageBody:
The supplied Shadow setup produces an executable JAR, but the UI suite
only tests classes compiled directly from source.

Add an optional JAR mode to the existing runner. Copy the artifact into
each isolated case directory and run it there, including restart cases,
so the release is tested without depending on the source checkout.

Document building, running, testing, and distributing phin.jar as a
release asset. Keep generated binaries excluded from Git.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add the SE-EDU Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Java conventions are provided outside the repository and are easy to
miss during later edits.

Add a project-specific skill with a review checklist and links to the
basic and intermediate rules. Keep the authoritative source available
for detailed cases and its Google Java fallback for uncovered topics.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add the SE-EDU Git standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Future commits need consistent subjects, explanatory bodies, and
cohesive scopes rather than relying on conventions from this chat.

Add a reusable project skill covering message structure, length limits,
branch naming, and staged-diff review. Preserve explicitly requested
course branch names and existing commit authorization requirements.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java formatting with SE-EDU conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
Switch labels and compact Javadoc blocks do not follow the required
layout, and one console statement exceeds the line-length limit.

Normalize indentation, document intentional fallthrough, expand header
comments, punctuate documentation tags, and wrap the long statement.
Keep command output and application behavior unchanged so this commit
can be reviewed independently of the parallel feature branch.

Verify all 19 JUnit tests and 14 UI cases with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Require project Java and Git standards in AGENTS
commitResults.messageBody:
The standards skills need an explicit entry point for future work.

Require reading the Java skill before code edits and the Git skill
before proposing or creating commits. Preserve existing test and
authorization rules and separate standalone instruction changes.

Keep CLAUDE.md unchanged because it already imports AGENTS.md.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Javadoc for public APIs
commitResults.messageBody:
Several public methods and fields lack full API documentation, and the
compact comments do not consistently describe parameters, returns, or
exceptions.

Document every non-private production class, constructor, method, and
field, plus the nontrivial private storage helpers. Keep descriptions
focused on contracts and side effects without changing application
behavior.

Verify private Javadoc with doclint, all 19 JUnit tests, and all 14 UI
cases using Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command for task descriptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Users can list every task but cannot narrow the list when looking for a
particular description.

Add a case-sensitive, phrase-based find command that preserves task
order and reports matching tasks without changing or saving the list.
Reject blank searches with command-specific guidance and include find
in unknown-command help.

Cover valid, empty, case-sensitive, no-match, repeated, and multiword
searches in unit and UI tests. Verify 24 JUnit tests and all 15 UI cases
with Java 25, including persistence across a restart.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-JavaDoc into master
commitResults.messageBody:
The JavaDoc increment documents all non-private production APIs and the
nontrivial private storage helpers without changing behavior.

Integrate the independently developed documentation before the coding
standard and find branches so later conflicts can be resolved against
the most complete API contracts.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-CodingStandard into master
commitResults.messageBody:
The coding-standard branch adds reusable Java and Git skills, mandates
them in AGENTS.md, and aligns Java layout with the SE-EDU rules.

Resolve documentation conflicts in Storage, TaskDate, TaskList, and Ui
by retaining the fuller JavaDoc contracts from A-JavaDoc. Preserve the
coding branch's switch indentation, explicit fallthrough, test layout,
and wrapped console statement without changing its output.

Verify private doclint, all 19 JUnit tests, and all 14 UI cases with
Java 25 after resolving the conflicts.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-9 into master
commitResults.messageBody:
The find increment searches task descriptions without changing or
saving the task list, and adds focused unit and console coverage.

Resolve insertion conflicts in Phin, TaskList, and Ui by adding the new
command and methods to the documented, formatted master versions.
Preserve the fuller neighboring API contracts instead of accepting
either file wholesale.

Verify all 24 JUnit tests, all 15 UI cases, and private Javadoc doclint
with Java 25 after the final merge resolution.
